title: Border and Debt
author: C. M. Quintana
blurb: Rafael Amberdale, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
